name: Bac Ninh Legacy Marathon 2027
short_description: Bac Ninh Legacy Marathon 2027 is on Sunday 10 January 2027 at the Kinh Bac Cultural Centre square in Suoi Hoa ward, Bac Ninh, over 5 km, 10 km, 21 km and 42 km.
ai_summary: Bac Ninh Legacy Marathon 2027 is on Sunday 10 January 2027, organised by DHA Vietnam, and moves the race to early January. It is based at the central square of the Kinh Bac Cultural Centre on Kinh Duong Vuong street, Suoi Hoa ward. The organisers describe a flat, open course with no bridges or slopes, over 42 km, 21 km, 10 km and 5 km.

core_facts.venue: Kinh Bac Cultural Centre square, Kinh Duong Vuong street, Suoi Hoa ward

faqs.question: How much does Bac Ninh Legacy Marathon 2027 cost?
faqs.answer: Fees rise through four tiers. The 42 km costs 450,000 VND at super early bird, 500,000 at early bird, 550,000 at regular (16 November to 15 December) and 800,000 VND late. The 21 km follows the same steps to 700,000 VND, and the 5 km and 10 km reach 500,000 VND in the late tier.

faqs.question: What are the age and transfer rules at Bac Ninh Legacy Marathon 2027?
faqs.answer: Runners must be over 16 for the 21 km and 42 km, over 12 for the 10 km and over five for the 5 km. Transfers cost 99,000 VND before 10 December and 299,000 VND from 11 to 31 December, and personal details can be changed until 31 December 2026.
